<!--
Same closed set of headings as the Task template, same order. Problem,
Proposal and Acceptance criteria are required.

Title: "feat(<optional scope>): <imperative>" - the same vocabulary as
commits. Lowercase after the colon, no trailing period.

Before writing the Proposal: this tool refuses rather than guesses, and a
capability that needs it to guess in order to be convenient is the one kind
of request that will be declined. See the rule in CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
